text: Create a third—the field of relationship. There is you, there is your beloved person, and there is a third—the very space in which your relationship manifests. Take care of this space. Do not pollute it with unexpressed resentments, lies, manipulations. Treat it like a canvas. Keep it clean, and paint the picture with the colors you like—awareness, sincerity, attention to each other, heartfelt warmth... A beautiful picture will delight, heal, and nourish you both.
